The Official Roster & Ecosystem Artists

In the Cosmos, every artist anchors a distinct emotional thesis within their Level and Fold. Explore our 7 core acts grouped by their multiversal era below.

LEVEL 1 FOLD 1 (1_1) Celestial Origin Plane • 300,000 YA — Present

The Celestial Origin & Twin-Flame Convergence

The primordial plane where Ra blessed the union of Time & Fate, giving birth to Pandora Raven and Elara Dawn. Separated across dimensions, they march toward the Album 9 Convergence as Solara.

Pandora Raven

Daughter of Time & Fate. The Light Twin raised in darkness who opens what should not be opened.

Elara Dawn

The Sun. Unbroken warrior bearing the North Star's light, riding toward the 300,000-year convergence.

Solara

The Twin-Flame Convergence entity born when both halves become whole at Album 9.

LEVEL 12 FOLD 15 (12_15) Indie Rock & Stadium Pop Era • Modern Era

The Musical Revolution & Stadium Pop Legends

The vibrant era where raw underground ska-punk transforms into stadium pop. The Crimson Sparks ignite the movement, Maya inherits the legacy guitar, and That Guy breaks cages against corporate chains.

The Crimson Sparks

Suki, Soren, Sky, Sol, and Sienna. Spark → Fire → Crash → Ignite → Movement → Wildfire → Embers.

Maya

Voice of emotional resonance carrying the legacy guitar. From Preflight to Strings and Theories.

That Guy

Angry All The Time. Navigating corporate chains, mosquitoes, love, and consequences across Saevit Animo.

LEVEL 15 FOLD 15 (15_15) Scavenger Plane & Wasteland Sanctuary • Wasteland Era

The Scavenger End Game & Primatown Sanctuary

The post-collapse scrap dunes where an Awakened Machine (Core 2) and Scavenger Boy (Core 1) build Primatown, rescue discarded machines, and prepare for Solara's arrival at Gate 17.

Prima & Timo

The awakened machine (Core 2) and scavenger boy (Core 1) navigating the Great Cycle, MAR, and Gate 17.
